description: Fix player invite/claim authentication flow and improve player management UX

userStories.title: Fix PlayerClaimView to link auth_user_id to player record
userStories.description: As a player claiming an invite, I want my auth credentials linked to my existing player record so the system knows I'm a player.
acceptanceCriteria: PlayerClaimView validates invite code and retrieves the existing player record
After successful Supabase auth signup, update the player's auth_user_id in Supabase
Use Supabase client to update players table: set auth_user_id = new auth user's ID where invite_code matches
Show appropriate error if invite code is invalid or expired
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update AuthManager to detect player role and route correctly
userStories.description: As a player logging in, I want to be routed to the player experience (PlayerMainView) instead of the bookie experience.
acceptanceCriteria: AuthManager checks if authenticated user has a player record (auth_user_id matches) in Supabase
If player record exists, set userRole = .player and currentPlayerId
If no player record but bookie record exists, set userRole = .bookie (current behavior)
AuthGateView routes to PlayerMainView when userRole is .player
Player can log out and log back in, still routed correctly
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Move logout button to SettingsView main screen
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the logout button on the main settings screen so I can easily log out.
acceptanceCriteria: Logout button is visible on SettingsView (not buried in AccountView or sub-view)
Button uses Theme.danger color for background
Tapping shows confirmation alert before logging out
Works for both bookie and player roles
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add delete player functionality
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to delete a player so I can remove test data or inactive players.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete button or swipe action available in PlayerDetailView
Confirmation alert appears before deletion with player name
If player has bets or ledger entries, show warning that history will be deleted
Player is deleted from local SwiftData context
Player needsSync is not relevant - use direct Supabase delete for immediate removal
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add player creation interstitial screen
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to see options when adding a player for future seat purchasing.
acceptanceCriteria: When tapping Add Player button in PlayersListView, show interstitial sheet first
Interstitial has two options: 'Add Player' and 'Purchase Seats'
Add Player option dismisses interstitial and shows AddPlayerSheet
Purchase Seats shows alert with 'Coming Soon' message
Uses Theme colors and styling consistent with app
Typecheck passes
